report:
Reviewed the complete deterministic_emission claim, all three ordinary implementation entries, and the sole associated TODO test. Requirements are (1) each emitter owns deterministic identities and semantic ordering, (2) identities exist before emission even for forward references, and (3) comparison never sorts, renumbers, or repairs outputs.

Sage emit_module creates fresh emitter state and calls pre_register_mod before emit_mod. Registration assigns sequential local IDs into a vector, rejects duplicate registrations, recursively registers modules, registers enum variants, source impl functions, named aliases and associated types, and finishes before any body is emitted. local_id is lookup-only and fails for missing emitted definitions; normalize_def resolves references against the completed table, including mapping variant constructors to variants. emit_mod traverses the same expanded item sequence and source_impl_functions sequence used during registration. Field, variant, parameter, type-argument, expression-argument, and statement vectors retain native semantic traversal order. External identities are projected into named, kind-tagged path segments, rather than allocated in encounter order.

Oracle emit_crate similarly constructs fresh state and calls pre_register_module before emit_module. Registration walks the module free-items sequence and recursively registers modules, enum variants, aliases, associated types and source impl functions. Lookup during emission cannot allocate a late ID. The same module and impl sequences drive emitted items. LocalMap numbers body locals by deterministic parameter/statement traversal. External def_path_for walks parent definitions and reverses that path inside the emitter to obtain root-to-leaf semantic order; this is projection, not comparator repair. Constructor references map to parent definitions. Each emitter can therefore resolve a later definition using the ID already assigned by its own traversal. Stable here means stable for the same semantic input/traversal, not that moving declarations must preserve their numerical IDs; reordered fixtures require their own expected order.

The newly associated assert_crates_eq takes immutable completed crates, serializes each directly, and passes the resulting strings to assert_serialized_text_eq. That helper returns success only on exact string equality. Parsing and strict structural diff happen only after inequality and both diagnostic branches return Err. No comparator branch sorts collections, rewrites IDs, canonicalizes input, or accepts repaired output. Fixture discovery sorting in the same file orders which fixtures run and does not mutate emitted values.

The complete associated test set consists of sage_meta::todo::crates_sage_oracle_harness_crate_deterministic_emission. Its empty body is explicitly TODO, not behavioral evidence. The comment identifies the prerequisite for completing coverage: associate and review a complete suite of independently expected repeated emissions, forward-reference fixtures, deliberately reordered fixtures, and namespace-kind/identity-order checks. That explicit evidence-inventory and scenario gap remains deferred; this report does not claim repeated-run stability or all identity/order mutations are currently tested. No N/A or implementation TODO entry is present. Existing unsupported-value behavior is governed separately by independent_coverage; this review does not certify full supported-language coverage.

Source review inspected the complete captured emitter and comparator files and their relevant internal helpers. Extra review policy and containing model were captured with review read. After the association-only edit, cargo fmt completed, a fresh start captured the current association set, and cargo test -p sage-oracle-harness --lib comparison_tests::exact_text_is_the_conformance_boundary passed (1 test). That supplementary comparator test checks exact identical text succeeds and structurally equal differently spaced text fails; it is not an associated replacement for the TODO determinism suite. No emitter determinism regression suite was run. Centralized post-codegen and Sage sanity delegation is owned by the coordinator.
